text: 据新华社，中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅在京同沙特国务大臣、内阁成员、国家安全顾问艾班举行会谈。艾班转交了沙特王储兼首相穆罕默德就中沙双边关系发展和双方共同关心的问题致习近平主席的信函。
text_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Office of the Central Commission for Foreign Affairs, held talks in Beijing with Saudi Minister of State, Cabinet Member and National Security Advisor Aliban. Aliban handed over a letter from Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed to President Xi Jinping on the development of China-Saudi bilateral relations and issues of common concern to both sides.
